mapper.insert: insert into assignment( assignment_no, course_no, employee_no, assignment_title, assignment_content, assignment_status, assignment_due_date ) values( #{assignmentNo}, #{courseNo}, #{employeeNo}, #{assignmentTitle}, #{assignmentContent}, #{assignmentStatus}, #{assignmentDueDate} )
mapper.select:
select ass.assignment_no, ass.course_no, c.course_title, ass.employee_no, acc.account_name, ass.assignment_title, ass.assignment_content, ass.assignment_status, ass.assignment_due_date, ass.assignment_wtime
from assignment ass
join course c on ass.course_no = c.course_no
join employee e on ass.employee_no = e.employee_no
join account acc on e.account_no = acc.account_no
where ass.assignment_no = #{assignmentNo}

select s.submit_no, s.assignment_no, a.assignment_title, s.student_no, acc.account_name, s.submit_wtime, s.submit_etime
from assignment_submit s
join assignment a on s.assignment_no = a.assignment_no
join student st on s.student_no = st.student_no
join account acc on st.account_no = acc.account_no
order by s.submit_no desc

select ass.assignment_no, ass.course_no, c.course_title, ass.assignment_title, ass.assignment_status, ass.assignment_due_date, ass.assignment_wtime
from assignment ass
join course c on ass.course_no = c.course_no
where ass.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
order by ass.assignment_no desc

select ass.assignment_no, ass.course_no, c.course_title,
acc.account_name,
ass.assignment_title, ass.assignment_status, ass.assignment_due_date, ass.assignment_wtime,
s.submit_no, s.submit_comment, s.submit_wtime, s.submit_etime
from assignment ass
join course c on ass.course_no = c.course_no
join employee e on ass.employee_no = e.employee_no
join account acc on e.account_no = acc.account_no
join student_course sc on ass.course_no = sc.course_no
left join assignment_submit s on ass.assignment_no = s.assignment_no and s.student_no = #{studentNo}
where sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.student_course_relation = '수강중'
order by ass.assignment_due_date asc, ass.assignment_no desc

select ass.assignment_no, ass.course_no, c.course_title,
ass.employee_no, acc.account_name,
ass.assignment_title, ass.assignment_status, ass.assignment_due_date, ass.assignment_wtime
from assignment ass
join course c on ass.course_no = c.course_no
join employee e on ass.employee_no = e.employee_no
join account acc on e.account_no = acc.account_no
where ass.course_no = #{courseNo}
order by ass.assignment_no desc
mapper.update: update assignment set assignment_title = #{assignmentTitle}, assignment_content = #{assignmentContent}, assignment_status = #{assignmentStatus}, assignment_due_date = #{assignmentDueDate} where assignment_no = #{assignmentNo}
